method: Independent mathematical analysis of actual official statements. No inaccessible editorial is claimed read.

reviews.statement_summary: Rooted command tree with up to200000 officers/queries; return the k-th preorder entry of a queried subtree in increasing-child order.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: Preorder makes each subtree a contiguous interval starting at tin[u] with length size[u]. Answer order[tin[u]+k-1] if k<=size[u], else-1. Children are appended in increasing input index, or sort explicitly. O(N+Q) after ordering; iterative traversal avoids deep-recursion overflow. Count u itself at k1.

reviews.statement_summary: Find x in1..1e9 with exactly k values<=x; duplicates allowed,k may be0 or n.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: Sort. For0<k<n choose the k-th value only if strictly smaller than the next. For k0 choose1 only if minimum>1; for k=n choose maximum. A duplicate block makes count jump over an unattainable k. O(NlogN).

reviews.statement_summary: Reorder a guaranteed-feasible sequence of up to100 values<=3e18, each next equal to previous/3 or previous*2.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: Sort by decreasing exponent of3 then increasing value. A divide-by3 lowers the exponent; multiplying by2 keeps it and increases value. Every valid path must obey this strict key order; existence is guaranteed. Count factors with integer division, not floating logs.

reviews.statement_summary: Count simple-cycle components in a simple undirected graph with up to200000 vertices/edges.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: Traverse each component, requiring degree2 at every vertex. A finite connected simple2-regular graph is exactly one cycle of length>=3. Paths, isolated vertices and cycles with branches fail. O(N+M). EdgeCount=vertexCount alone is insufficient.

reviews.statement_summary: Output indices of a longest subsequence whose values increase by exactly1;N<=200000,values<=1e9.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: Scan left-to-right. best[x] stores the longest processed chain ending in x. Extend best[x-1], record its endpoint as predecessor, and update x if improved. A maximal chain dominates shorter chains of the same ending value. Backtrack the best endpoint, reverse indices. O(NlogN) ordered map or expected O(N) hashing.

reviews.statement_summary: Return the k-th positive integer not divisible by n,where n>=2 and n,k<=1e9.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: Each n-sized block contains n-1 valid values. Zero-based rank k-1 gives k+floor((k-1)/(n-1)); or binary-search the first x with x-floor(x/n)>=k. k-1 handles exact block boundaries. Use64-bit arithmetic.

reviews.statement_summary: Count occurrences equaling a sum of at least two consecutive positive elements;values<=n,aggregate n<=8000.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: Enumerate interval sums of length>=2 and mark sums<=n; positivity allows stopping above n. Count original occurrences whose value is marked: duplicates count repeatedly but multiple representations do not. O(N²),O(N) extra memory; exclude length1.

reviews.statement_summary: Reconstruct binary string from counts of00,mixed01/10,and11 adjacent pairs; solution guaranteed,total pairs>0.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: For positive mixed count start alternating with mixedCount+1 characters. Expand the first zero run by n0 zeros and first one run by n2 ones; only equal-pair counts change. With zero mixed count, valid input requires one constant run. Length=n0+n1+n2+1; linear time.

reviews.statement_summary: Construct a permutation of2<=n<=1000 with adjacent differences2..4,or report none.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: n2,3 impossible. For n>=4 output decreasing odds to1,then4,2,then increasing evens from6. Internal differences2; bridges3,2,and optionally4. Every integer appears once; O(N).

reviews.statement_summary: Maximize disjoint two-person teams sharing a total weight;N<=50,weights<=n.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: Enumerate target sums2..2n. For unequal complementary weights add min frequencies once; equal pair contributes floor(freq/2). Complement classes are disjoint for fixed target, proving joint optimality. Take the best target; preserve participant multiplicity. O(n²) frequency-table method.

reviews.statement_summary: Partition a binary string into minimum alternating subsequences and output a group ID for every position.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: Map0 to+1,1 to-1 in the prefix walk. Assign each step to its undirected integer-level edge; crossings of one edge alternate direction. Groups used=maxPrefix-minPrefix. Between global extrema the interval imbalance has that magnitude; each alternating group contributes at most1, proving the lower bound. O(N); shift labels positive.

reviews.statement_summary: Given n vertices and n-1 roads,replace one existing road with one new road per day to make the graph connected with minimum days.
reviews.solution_proof_and_edge_cases: DSU builds a forest and records rejected cycle edges. With c components the forest has n-c edges,so exactly c-1 edges are redundant. Replace them one by one with links from an anchor to other representatives. Original forests stay connected; c-1 meets the connectivity lower bound. O(N alpha(N)).
